title: SimPay Mobile SDK conformance scenario
description: One end-to-end checkout run against a scripted API. A runner builds the checkout engine with a fake transport, a fake session provider and a manual clock, performs 'steps' in order and compares the outcome with 'expect'. No real network, no real payment.

id.description: Equal to the file name without .json.

since.description: Contract version that introduced the scenario.

order.description: bridge-v1 order fields overriding the runner's default order (amount 49.99 PLN, payer@example.com).

session.description: Session issued by the fake provider. Tokens are generated by the runner (mobsdk_test_<n>); scenarios never contain tokens.

api.description: Replies per endpoint, consumed in order; the last reply repeats. An endpoint without replies fails the call as not_delivered.

result.description: The single final result, in bridge-v1 form without 'version'. 'error.message' is not compared.

requests.description: Exact number of transport calls per endpoint. create_transaction and submit_blik_code are the mutating requests; their counts are mandatory.

androidToday.description: What Android SDK 1.0.0 does when it differs. Informational; the Android runner reports such scenarios as known divergences.

json.description: Response body, serialized by the runner.

accepted.description: What the action must report: true (default) when it was performed, false when it was ignored (not allowed in the current state) or did not succeed (for example channels could not be loaded).

step.description: run_polling: advance the manual clock through every poll interval until the checkout finishes or the budget ends.
